description: Patent search. Send keywords, a technology description or an assignee name; returns up to 10 Google Patents results with title, publication number, priority, filing, grant and publication dates, inventor, assignee, snippet and PDF link. Use for prior-art scans and competitor patent checks. Not legal advice. Typical response about 1 s. Failed calls are not charged. Costs $0.01 (USDC, x402).

country.description: Optional two-letter country code, lower case, such as us or gb.

language.description: Optional language code, lower case, such as en or pt-br.

query.description: Keywords, a technology description or an assignee name.
